sentence: This project studies how augmented reality and artificial intelligence tools can make hidden processes in nature, such as root growth and pollination, easier to see.
This project studies how vibration-assisted friction stir surfacing can make 3D-printed metal parts stronger and reduce internal defects.
This project tries to find out how red wolf ghost ancestry in coyote genomes can help endangered species recovery.
This project studies how rapid evolution in orchard flies competing with each other affects which species win, lose and coexist.
This project tries to find and reduce bias in medical decisions made by both humans and algorithms.
This project builds an imaging system with software that can analyze images to estimate growth rates and check health conditions in aquaculture facilities.
This project builds a biology curriculum that uses sequencing data and computational predictions to study how RNA molecules regulate biological systems.
This project builds an AI system that combines satellite and drone sensing to model the 3D structure of crops, including roots, and predict yield.
This project studies how graph signal processing and graph learning can help analyze data that evolve across both space and time.
This project tracks butterflies and moths in mountains to learn how temperature, precipitation and drought affect their populations.
This project studies how azirines, a class of reagents, can be tuned for selective modification of native proteins.
This project builds robots made from biological cells that can split apart or join together when controlled with different colors of light.
This project uses Bayesian deep learning to handle uncertainty in real-world imaging and to improve image reconstruction, including deep tissue imaging.
This project develops methods to measure how reliable the hidden structures found in large, complex datasets are.
